## Branch Naming Convention

### Active Branches
- `main` - Primary branch
- `academic-review-*` - Academic paper branches
- `feature-*` - New feature development
- `fix-*` - Bug fixes

### Archived Branches
- Tagged with `archive/` prefix or moved to archive remote
- Documented in this file

## Maintenance

- Old branches are kept for historical reference
- Can be deleted if no longer needed (after archival)
- Academic branches are protected and maintained
